description: A quoted iterator name is an error
notes: The README's example gives the iterator as a bare name, and doesn't say how the iterator attribute is read, or whether a quoted name, which is how the JSON syntax gives it (json/dynamic-blocks/iterator-name), also gives it. hashicorp/hcl reads the attribute with hcl.AbsTraversalForExpr (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go), which doesn't accept a template in the native syntax.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
